errors.text_span: Подобряване на индивидуалното представяне на участниците в курса с оглед спецификите на колектива, целите и средствата
errors.evidence: The description incorrectly transcribes the label for the red sector. The figure's legend uses the word "средата" (the environment), but the description uses the word "средствата" (the means/resources), which changes the meaning of the category.
The description omits the text below the title, "22 отговора" (22 answers), which indicates the total number of responses collected.

The description uses the word "приблизително" (approximately) when describing a value that is explicitly labeled as exactly 81.8% in the chart. The same applies to the description of the 18.2% sector as "около" (about).

errors.text_span: Секторите са подредени според размера си
errors.evidence: The statement that the sectors are "ordered by size" is an over-generalization. For a chart with only two slices, this is not a meaningful structural feature and implies a deliberate sorting that is not necessarily present.
